enforcement_focus: Physical goods — strategic materials to Soviet bloc
legislation: Mutual Defense Assistance Control Act (Battle Act) 1951
notes: Controls focused on tangible goods; enforcement at physical border

enforcement_focus: Dual-use technology; strategic goods to adversaries
notable_cases: Numerous Cold War dual-use diversion cases
notes: IEEPA gave Executive broad emergency powers; EAA focused on Commerce-controlled dual-use goods

notable_cases: Loral/Hughes satellite technology transfer to China 1998
notes: EAR codified in current form; ECCN system established; dual-use controls systematized

enforcement_focus: Terror finance; WMD; Iran/North Korea/Russia sanctions
legislation: Comprehensive Iran Sanctions, Accountability, and Divestiture Act 2010 (CISADA)
notes: Secondary sanctions extended US reach extraterritorially; financial sector became key enforcement vector

enforcement_focus: Emerging technologies; semiconductor controls; China tech
legislation: Foreign Investment Risk Review Modernization Act 2018
notable_cases: Huawei Entity List 2019 (HiSilicon/TSMC supply chain cut)
notes: ECRA gave BIS permanent statutory authority; Entity List became primary tech-competition tool; FDPR extended US controls to foreign-produced items with US content

enforcement_focus: AI chips; advanced semiconductors; China military modernization
legislation: BIS IFR: Controls for Advanced Computing and Semiconductor Manufacturing Items (Oct 2022)
notable_cases: CXMT, Yangtze Memory Entity List additions 2022
notes: TPP (Total Processing Performance) thresholds introduced; 3A090 ECCN for advanced GPUs/TPUs; AI governance intersects with export controls

enforcement_focus: AI model weights; agentic systems; cyber-predicate enforcement
perimeter: Logical access / API endpoint / connection (identity & access)
legislation: AI Diffusion Rule: Framework for Artificial Intelligence Diffusion (15 CFR Parts 734, 740, 742, 744)
notable_cases: DOJ Operation Gatekeeper Dec 2025 (AI-chip diversion UAE)
Anthropic v. DoD N.D. Cal. 3:26-cv-01996 (filed Mar 2026)
notes: Paradigm shift: controls extend to logical access and API connections; cyber-predicate used to trigger export-control measures; agentic AI systems create deemed-export surfaces at runtime
